title: What Makes a Good Move? Learning to Act from Experience in Visual Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2611.21065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning visual policies requires turning interaction experience into guidance for individual decisions. Trajectory outcomes obscure action quality, while unguided exploration can revisit familiar situations. We present \textsc{LightAct}, an experience-learning framework that connects skill-guided exploration with policy internalization. Interaction segments are summarized into experience entries and consolidated into a game-specific skill that guides root collection toward broader state coverage. At each root, candidate actions are compared through short rollouts under a shared frozen policy. Environment-reported score gains are averaged across continuations and normalized into relative action rewards, producing reusable supervision for reinforcement learning. Policy training uses a compact dataset of just 1,024 decision roots collected in a single source game and paired with their action rewards. Across 170 GameWorld tasks spanning 3

translated_title: 什么才是好的一步？在视觉世界中从经验中学习行动
translated_abstract: 学习视觉策略需要将交互经验转化为对单个决策的指导。轨迹层面的结果会掩盖动作质量，而无引导的探索可能反复访问已经熟悉的情境。我们提出了LightAct，这是一个将技能引导的探索与策略内化相连接的经验学习框架。交互片段被总结为经验条目，并整合成一种游戏特定的技能，该技能引导根节点收集以获得更广泛的状态覆盖。在每个根节点处，候选动作在共享的冻结策略下通过短程推演进行比较。环境报告的得分增益在多个后续延续中取平均，并归一化为相对动作奖励，从而产生可复用的强化学习监督信号。策略训练使用一个紧凑的数据集，仅包含在单一源游戏中收集的1,024个决策根节点，并与它们相应的动作奖励配对。在跨越3个（摘要此处截断）……共170个GameWorld任务上……
tldr: LightAct框架将技能引导的探索与策略内化相结合，把交互经验转化为相对动作奖励监督，仅用单一游戏中收集的1,024个决策根节点即可在170个GameWorld任务上学习视觉策略。
en_tdlr: LightAct connects skill-guided exploration with policy internalization by converting interaction experience into relative action rewards, enabling visual policy learning from just 1,024 decision roots collected in a single source game across 170 GameWorld tasks.
